te: Emperor Honorius signs an edict providing tax relief for the Italian provinces Tuscia, Campania, Picenum, Samnium, Apul…
dz: 霍诺利乌斯皇帝签署了一项法令,为被维西哥特人掠夺的意大利图西亚,坎帕尼亚,皮克纳姆,萨姆尼姆,阿普利亚,卢卡尼亚和卡拉布里亚等省份提供税收减免.
de: Emperor Honorius signs an edict providing tax relief for the Italian provinces Tuscia, Campania, Picenum, Samnium, Apulia, Lucania and Calabria, which were plundered by the Visigoths.
